department: PhD by Thesis, School of Engineering and Computer Science

deadline.value: The PhD rounds are 1 March, 1 July and 1 November, but the official page gives no year, so no 2027 deadline is recorded.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is stated for computer science.

supervisor.value: You do not need a confirmed supervisor before you apply; the school allocates one after acceptance.
supervisor.quote: you don’t need to have a confirmed supervisor before you apply

funding.value: Wellington Doctoral Scholarships are awarded competitively and availability is limited; the application is part of the PhD application.
funding.quote: Scholarships are awarded on a competitive basis and availability is limited.

entry_route.value: New Zealand graduates need a Bachelor's with Honours or a Master's with GPA 6 (B+); international applicants must have equivalent qualifications.
entry_route.quote: you will need a Bachelor’s degree with Honours or a Master’s degree, with an overall GPA or no less than 6 (letter grade B+) to apply to enrol for a PhD

also.quote: International applicants are expected to have equivalent academic qualifications to those required of New Zealand applicants.

notes: Explore page for computer science lists Doctor of Philosophy (PhD). Enrolment depends on supervisor availability and Associate Dean approval (ECS page); the FGR rule is used for supervisor. No department fee, GRE or English rule.
